prompt: Regarding computational complexity analysis: Finding the connected component of a node in Disjoint Set Union (DSU) with both Path Compression and Union by Rank. Which of the following correctly characterizes the complexity?
options: O(α(n)) amortized, where α is the inverse Ackermann function
explanation: Path compression flattens the tree while union by rank keeps depth shallow. Tarjan proved this achieves O(α(n)) amortized per operation, practically constant (< 5 for any realistic universe size).
